resume_text: Alex Morgan — Operations and Procurement Manager. 7 years of experience in supply chain planning, procurement, forecasting, and supplier performance. Senior Supply Chain Specialist at Sample Distribution Co. (2022-2026). Managed inventory replenishment and capacity planning across branches. Directed sourcing and purchase orders for 14 suppliers; improved supplier on-time delivery from 82% to 96% through scorecard reviews. Built Excel reporting for risk and demand forecasts. Procurement Analyst at Example Industries (2019-2022). Managed materials for production and purchase order fulfillment. Education: BS in Supply Chain Management. Systems: Excel, ERP, Power BI.

verified_facts.statement: Analyzed supply chain data in Excel, communicated findings to cross-functional stakeholders, and coordinated procurement, supplier lead-time recovery and warehouse teams.
